chunks: When he saw his shirt torn from the back, he said, 'Surely this is your ruse; surely your wile is great.'
ai.seo_question: What did Jacob say when he saw Joseph's shirt torn from the back?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Jacob (AS) interprets the torn shirt as a strategic clue: since it was torn from the back, Joseph must have been pulling away while the wife grabbed the front, exposing her lie. This moment highlights the concept of 'kayd' (cunning/deception), where Jacob acknowledges the potency of the women's plot while maintaining faith in divine wisdom despite the apparent evidence against his son.
